sections.title: उन्नत अवधारणा
sections.content: Level 3 में multiple transactions, compound profit/loss, partner profit ratio और inverse ratio profit sharing शामिल हैं। SP > CP → लाभ, SP < CP → हानि। उदाहरण: ₹100 का सामान पहले 10% लाभ में, फिर 5% हानि में बेचा गया।

sections.title: ₹ में multi-item और partner example
sections.content: एक व्यापारी ने अलग-अलग सामान खरीदे और बेचे। Partner profit sharing में ratios भी शामिल। उदाहरण: Item1: CP ₹200, SP ₹250; Item2: CP ₹150, SP ₹120; Partners ratio 2:3 → Profit share निकालें।

sections.title: Successive और Compound Profit/Loss %
sections.content:
Successive Profit %: [(1 + p1/100)(1 + p2/100) - 1] × 100
Successive Loss %: [1 - (1 - l1/100)(1 - l2/100)] × 100
Compound profit/loss = multi-step transactions में SP और CP को multiply/divide करके निकालें।

sections.title: महत्वपूर्ण सूत्र
sections.content:
1. SP = CP + लाभ
2. SP = CP - हानि
3. लाभ% = (लाभ ÷ CP) × 100
4. हानि% = (हानि ÷ CP) × 100
5. Successive Profit% = [(1+p1/100)(1+p2/100)...-1]×100
6. Successive Loss% = [1-(1-l1/100)(1-l2/100)...]×100
7. Partner Profit = Total Profit × (Partner Ratio ÷ Total Ratio)

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content: Successive/compound calculations को सीधे जोड़ना, partner ratio भूलना, multi-item CP/SP सही न निकालना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content: Level 3 में multi-item, successive/compound profit/loss, partner ratio, inverse ratio शामिल। SP > CP → लाभ, SP < CP → हानि।

tricks.title: Successive Profit/Loss shortcut
tricks.explanation: Successive % को सीधे न जोड़ें, formula: (1+p1/100)(1+p2/100)-1।

tricks.title: Compound Profit/Loss quick trick
tricks.explanation: Multiple transactions: SP/CP stepwise calculate, फिर total %।
tricks.example: CP ₹100, SP ₹120, next SP ₹120 → total profit% ≈ 44%

tricks.title: Partner Profit ratio trick
tricks.explanation: Profit share = Total Profit × (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio)

tricks.title: Inverse ratio profit sharing
tricks.explanation: Loss/profit inversely proportional to CP contribution

tricks.title: Multi-item Profit/Loss quick check
tricks.explanation: Separate CP/SP निकालें, net जोड़ें, फिर % calculate करें।
tricks.example: Item1: CP 100 SP 120; Item2: CP 150 SP 140 → Net Profit 10

tricks.title: Discount + Profit/Loss shortcut
tricks.explanation: SP = Marked Price - Discount, फिर Profit/Loss % निकालें।

tricks.title: Multi-step transaction mental trick
tricks.explanation: Stepwise CP/SP निकालें, total जोड़ें, final % निकालें।
tricks.example: Item1 CP ₹50 SP ₹60; Item2 CP ₹80 SP ₹75 → Net Loss = 5

tricks.title: Partner + Compound trick
tricks.explanation: Compound transactions में partner ratio apply करें।
